entries.title: Duel fixes and battle wheel updates
changes: Mew and Shiny Mew can use Genetic Chaos at the start of your turn, before playing a Plate. After transforming, you can move or attack with Mew, or end your turn. Its figure card shows Mew’s name and the Pokémon it copied.
Night Daze no longer turns field spins into Misses for moves such as Earthquake and Rock Slide. It still affects battle spins.
Ditto now wins the duel when its Incarnate Forme copy expires on the opponent’s goal.
Battle wheel figures now use consistent framing. Mew and Shiny Mew appear smaller, and Shiny Mew’s sparkle is visible.
Replays keep the transformation and field-spin rules from the recorded duel.
Mobile duels use less memory. The Team Plates buttons now sit below the cards.
Ranked Play Again loads the opponent’s figures before validating their team. Database, Quests, My Collection, Leaderboard, Challenges and My Team are hidden during Ranked search.

entries.title: Mew and portrait controls
changes: Mew and Shiny Mew can end their turn immediately after using Genetic Chaos or continue with the copied MP.
In portrait Team Builder, tap − on an occupied slot to remove that Pokémon.
View Model is beside Related Figures. Tapping Close in portrait returns to the same figure and preserves unsaved team edits.

entries.title: Mew and Shiny Mew
changes: To celebrate 1,500 Discord members, Shiny Mew EX joins the roster as a gift figure.
Mew and Shiny Mew gain Genetic Chaos. Before making an MP move, choose another Pokémon on the field to copy its Wheel, MP, Type and Ability until the end of your opponent's next turn.
Hyper Sonic deals 41 damage. A team can include one Mew across both editions. Existing teams with more than one need to be edited before play.
Poipole and Shiny Poipole can use Spaceborne to reach an empty point along a three-step route, even when there is a shorter route to the same point. The route can cross occupied points.
Big Chorus blocks named Mega Stones when three qualifying Poli-family figures are on the field.
Eon Flute can recall an excluded Eon Twin. Twins in Ultra Space stay there and appear only in the Ultra Space list.
Plate prompts appear above player banners. Gym and Elite Four passive cards clear the landscape Chat and Settings controls.
The portrait Player Hub shows a larger update notice. Browser players see optional Windows, Android and Mac download links after signing in.

entries.title: Tutorial and Battle Fixes
changes: Giovanni’s Kanto tutorial can play his scripted Reckless Charge opening in the browser.
Misty’s tutorial now has Floatzel and Kabuto land Aqua Jet directly so the lesson can continue. Kabuto’s ability is labeled Emergent Evolution and lets it evolve after battle without a respin.

White and Gold attacks now resolve their ordinary effects on draws and losses against other White or Gold attacks. Explicit win and knockout conditions, repeat-spin rules, and the rules saved with older replays are preserved.
Pichu’s Nuzzle paralyzes the battle opponent on White and Gold ties and losses. Tornadus Incarnate’s Heat Wave still resolves if it is knocked out by White or Gold damage.
Arceus keeps its chosen type when Multitype is nullified.
Rocky Helmet works when Magikarp uses Rapid Evolution to survive a damage knockout.
U-turn switches when a legal reserve is available. With multiple valid Pokémon, you choose which one to switch in.
Spaceborne highlights open points exactly three steps away by the shortest open route.
Reveal Glass awards a goal win when an eligible genie changes form on the opponent’s goal.
Figure Collection keeps upgrade levels visible after the portrait layout finishes loading.
Figure Library, Figure Collection, and Team Builder offer AND and OR type filters in the app and browser.
Fixed Bind’s typo and other roster text. Clarified Warp Hole, Play Rough, Rare Eevee, Tentacle Barrage, Druddigon’s Revenge, Crabhammer, and Double Slap.

entries.title: Replay Compatibility
changes: Older replays load archived figure and Plate data with the rules recorded for the duel. This preserves the original movement and Ability behavior for figures such as Mega Blaziken and Manaphy.
New replays save their own figure stats, wheels, Ability settings, and forms so future balance updates can preserve their playback.
Steelix R’s Pull In now has two stars. Replays from the released v1.4.0 build keep the three-star version.

entries.title: Balance Update
changes: Charmeleon — Iron Tail 50 → 70
Wartortle — Water Gun 50 → 70
Mega Mewtwo X and Shiny Mega Mewtwo X — Psystrike 170 → 160
Pichu — Nuzzle replaces Thunder Shock. It is a 30-damage White Attack that paralyzes the battle opponent.
Chesnaught — Hammer Arm 100 → 140
Quilladin — Mud Shot 40 → 70. The 50-damage Needle Arm segment goes to 80.
Celebi EX — Dazzling Gleam 70 replaces Energy Ball as a White Attack. Adjacent opposing Pokémon spin and are knocked out if they spin Gold.
Arceus and Shiny Arceus — Extreme Speed 150 → 130 and Judgement 170 → 150
Garchomp EX — Dragon Rush 130 → 140
Steelix EX — Iron Tail 170 → 150. Pull In replaces Take Away and retains its two stars.
Aegislash Blade Forme — Shadow Sneak 130 → 110
Darkrai EX — Dark Pulse 130 → 150
Groudon EX — Break Energy 100 → 90. Miss expands from 4 to 8 segments and Fissure shrinks from 24 to 20.
Primal Groudon — The 8-segment Dodge becomes Miss. Precipice Blades expands from 32 to 36, Flamethrower from 28 to 32, and Continental Shift shrinks from 24 to 16.
Sharpedo EX — Liquidation 160 → 140 and Aqua Jet 70 → 80.
Mega Sharpedo — Base Liquidation 170 → 140 and base Fang Finale 140 → 110. After Mega Evolution, these are 150 and 120 before Ability bonuses, with three-star Wash Out.

Ripped Sky Reign makes the Blue Attacks of opponents battling your Dragon-type Pokémon become Misses. It also nullifies Ability effects that increase those opponents’ damage or stars. This applies to Mega Rayquaza and its shiny counterpart.
Garchomp’s Sand Veil remains available after you decline. Using it successfully consumes it until Garchomp enters the field again.

Eon Twins replaces Hallucination on Latios and Latias. On knockout they are excluded and return to the Bench five turns later. While you have an excluded Latios or Latias, the twin on the field gains Twin Recall in place of Dodge or Fly Away. It returns a twin to an adjacent point with Wait.
Infatuated sets the affected Pokémon’s MP to 0 while it is adjacent to the Pokémon that attached the marker.
Blaze Boogie burns opposing Pokémon Mega Blaziken MP moves over and knocks out Pokémon that are already burned. It no longer grants an evolution-based MP bonus.
Pull In moves the user first, then its battle opponent, to the user’s P.C.
King’s Shield gives the battle opponent Wait. Aegislash switches forms through Stance Change.
Kabuto’s Battle Armor lets it evolve after a battle if it is still on the field.

Manaphy EX now has 2 MP and can MP move over allied Water Pokémon. Ocean’s Gift gives your Water Pokémon +20 damage and burn immunity while Manaphy is on the field. The bonus applies once. During your turn, opposing Abilities that prevent your Water Pokémon’s damage increases are nullified.
Primal Rage G and K give their eligible allies +20 damage. The aura no longer adds stars.
Primordial Sea and Desolate Land grant +10 damage and +1 star to allied Water and Fire Pokémon on the field, respectively. Multiple copies of the same Ability grant the bonus once.
Red Orb and Blue Orb each cost 1 and trigger Primal Reversion. Their former Plate bonuses are removed.
Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre are Form-only in player decks. Replace any starting Primal before using the deck in a new match. Active Elite Four runs can continue with their locked teams.
Kartana’s Paper Sword sends a Cracked opponent to Ultra Space only when Kartana knocks it out by dealing damage. Surround knockouts go to the P.C.
Shiny Charizard, Shiny Mega Charizard X, and Shiny Mega Charizard Y now match their regular counterparts’ wheels and abilities.
In Rainbow Mayhem, Trickery cannot shift a spin when its Purple attack loses to Gold.
Challenge Mode is available from Play in portrait and landscape. Challenges on the Player Hub opens your challenge progress.
Random Team is available when hosting or joining a custom lobby.
Create Team and Edit Team are available from the Gym and Elite Four team pickers.
Figure Usage has separate balance tabs for My Figures and Global Figures. The v1.4.0 tab starts at zero and counts matches played under the new balance rules. Earlier usage remains under v1.0.0.
Hover over a disabled Save Team button or tap it to see what needs fixing.
In portrait duels, tap an eligible player banner to view the player’s profile.

entries.title: Team imports and Reckless Charge
changes: Import Team Code accepts uppercase, lowercase, or mixed-case prefixes. You can paste a copied code directly.
The browser opens imported teams in the standard Team Builder in portrait and landscape. Back and Save Team are available, and invalid codes show an error in the import dialog.
Rhyperior's Reckless Charge allows up to two steps from the bench, with the Entry Point counting as the first step.

entries.title: Gameplay and portrait fixes
changes: Backdraft now checks who was adjacent to the battle opponent before it moved, so eligible opposing Pokémon are sent to their P.C. on wins, ties, and eligible losses.
Ho-Oh’s Serene Light now checks Ho-Oh’s own P.C. when returning Pokémon to their benches.
Spaceborne now finds open points reachable by a three-step route, including points that also have a shorter route.
Standardized knocked out wording in Explosion, Dragon Tail, Hydro Kick, Abyssal Grip, Tentacle Barrage, and Night Stalker. Tentacle Barrage now uses the status names Poisoned and Noxious.
Wheel Modification now lets you refund and reassign expansion points even when the wheel already has redistribution points assigned.
In portrait browser mode, tapping a Figure or Plate opens the selected card immediately.
In portrait duels, tapping the board outside the Pokémon info drawer closes it and lets the tap reach the board.
The portrait turn counter now counts down from 300 in standard duels and follows the turn limit in custom lobbies.

entries.title: Gameplay and mobile interface fixes
changes: Porygon’s Trace now applies the Primal Rage effect it copies from Kyogre, Groudon, or Rayquaza, including the bonuses for eligible allies.
Steelix’s Take Away only sends Steelix to the Bench after its opponent reaches Steelix’s P.C.
Fixed the Giovanni tutorial so it can be completed under the current movement rules. This fix is already live in the browser.
Tap outside the Pokémon info drawer to close it. You can still drag it to expand.
Open Chat and Settings from the Duel Menu. Portrait chat fills the available screen and hides Expand.
Sphere, Trick Room, and other field effects sit below the player banners. The turn counter hides while an effect prompt is open.
Match Over and other dialogs fit their content and scroll when needed.
Load Full Leaderboard stays within the screen.
Sandbox Tools can be opened by tapping in either orientation. In portrait, the button sits above the turn banner.
Enlarged the Plate deck screen and its text.

entries.title: Battle, replay and interface fixes
changes: Cosmoem can now evolve through Black Core when Rare Candy evolves Cosmog and completes a surround.
Nebby’s Power can now bring your Solgaleo or Lunala out of the P.C. and onto an open point next to Cosmog.
Mega Gengar’s Otherworldly Talons no longer lets the board highlight illegal MP destinations for affected Pokémon. Legal attacks remain available.
Surrounds are now checked after Mega Evolution expires. If reverting clears Sleep or Freeze and completes a surround, the knockout resolves before the next player acts.
Rhyperior’s Reckless Charge no longer turns a 3 MP move into four straight steps. When moving from the bench, the entry point counts as one step.
Extreme Evoboost now stacks, adding another +50 damage each time it’s used.
Guardian of Alola now appears as a Fairy-type move in the Z-Move selection menu.
Previous Page and Next Page now stay visible above the scrollable match list. Back to Player Hub takes up less space in the footer.
Shared private lobby replays now retain the match’s settings, including whether Chain levels were disabled. This also applies when Aegislash changes to Blade Forme.
The Plate confirmation now appears above the match banners and stays centered on narrow screens.
Enabled buttons in mobile Wheel Modification are brighter and bolder, and disabled buttons are dimmed.
Signed-in browser players continue to count toward Players Online while playing a duel in a visible tab.
Mirror Coat on Corsola and Tentacruel now uses Blastoise’s wording. “If the battle opponent spins a Purple Attack, it is knocked out.”
Land’s Wrath on Zygarde 50% Forme now reads “All other Pokémon on the field spin. Those that spin Purple Attacks are knocked out.”
Rock Slide on Durant, Onix, Tyranitar, and Mega Aerodactyl now reads “All neighbor Pokémon spin. Those that spin a Miss are knocked out.”

entries.title: Battle, Plate and room fixes
changes: Z-moves that affect spaces behind their target now follow the original attack direction without turning corners.
Reckless Charge uses the correct Bench movement distance and handles Air Balloon and Mud Coating together.
Impact Charge now qualifies for battle evolution when it sends the opponent to the Bench.
Gracidea recognizes Shaymin Land Forme and loads Sky Forme when used.
Sandbox can refresh Plates. Restorer only targets eligible Pokémon in your own Pokémon Center.
Rooms show each player's team readiness and let you copy the lobby code.
Native and browser clients show the shared Ranked and Casual cooldown notice when the account server reports one.
Browser Match History keeps its portrait layout and returns cleanly from replays.
The native updater can parse four-part versions. This update uses v1.3.10 so existing installs can receive it automatically.
A separate private server update contains shared Ranked and Casual cooldowns, public gameplay profiles, and grouped cosmetic variants in figure usage statistics.

entries.title: Disguise and Cotton Guard fixes
changes: Disguise: The marker remains until it prevents a knockout, including after battles lost without a knockout.
Cotton Guard: Protection expires after the Pokémon’s next battle, including wins and draws.
Browser rewards: Fixed missing reward artwork on the paused post-battle reward screen.
Lava Plume: Removed “by a White or Gold Attack” from the description.
Volt Switch: Added “You may” to clarify that switching is optional.
Trickery: Added “You may” to clarify that shifting the result is optional.

entries.title: Mobile and duel hotfix
changes: Fixed an Android crash when upgrading figures in portrait and corrected the display of owned upgrade materials.
Fixed the Match History footer on first open in desktop landscape.
Fixed an end-of-duel freeze that could leave a blank, blocking results panel after rotation. The fix applies to the app and browser.
Added the full HTML portrait menu to the main browser game, including the updated team previews and Pokémon cards. The layout adapts when you rotate your phone.

entries.title: Mobile UI and gameplay fixes
changes: New mobile vertical UI.
Zygarde: Power Construct now requires two Pokémon belonging to its player in the same PC.
Knockout effects: Corkscrew Crash and other KO-triggered effects now activate when the defeated opponent changes form instead of entering the PC.
Taunt: Now affects the initial spin only, preventing repeating attacks such as Icicle Spear from looping incorrectly.
Primal Groudon: Can now choose to revert when knocked out by Fissure.
Rhyperior: Fixed straight-line movement from the bench toward the center-left/right spaces.
Air Balloon: No longer allows Rhyperior to exceed 2 MP.
Lovely Battlefield: Normal/Fighting Pokémon receive both type bonuses, giving Mega Lopunny +20 damage.
Night Daze: Correctly applies its status effect on draws and losses against White/Gold attacks.
Wash Out: Correctly applies Wait after knockback.
Fixed field spin wheels being hidden beneath figures in portrait.
Added the missing field-wheel animation for Leer.
Improved victory lighting and removed the repeated zoom-out/zoom-in transition.
Added opponent reporting after a duel, including from the end-duel menu.
Improved browser session handling to prevent temporary errors and cached-page returns from unnecessarily signing players out.
Figure usage now counts completed matches from the shared Ranked/Casual queue, excluding Mayhem, private rooms, and offline matches.

entries.title: Duel fixes, mobile cards, and lobby settings
changes: Reckless Charge now works as a normal MP move. Rhyhorn, Rhydon, and Rhyperior can move two points straight or one diagonally at base MP.
Blackout applies Wait only when paralysis starts. Rally gives Ember +20 damage per figure in your P.C.
Portrait duels open a smaller slide-up Pokémon card. Settings offers an optional top card with a Details button.
Evolution and form previews are tappable buttons at the bottom of the mobile card.
Custom lobby settings now sit below Random Team and include separate battle-only switches for figure levels and Chain Level bonuses.
Excluded Plates have a red X. Hover or tap to see what excluded them.
Returning from a replay restores the Match History tab, page, search, and filters.

entries.title: Wait-loss fixes and collection sorting
changes: Fixed premature Wait losses when a frozen Entry Point still allows a legal deployment.
Wait-loss checks now finish battle and turn-start effects, including Final Song, before judging available actions. Legal Plates and Abilities count as actions.
Generator now displays its move name, with clear next-turn and this-turn wording.
Added highest and lowest Chain Level sorting to the figure collection.
Browser Kanto Hard and Expert now use your selected team. Normal tutorials keep their provided teams.

entries.title: Battle fixes, duel reporting, and vertical layout
changes: Black and White Kyurem can move through occupied Entry Points from the bench.
Fixed premature Wait losses when Celebi can use Time Travel, including from the P.C.
Mid-Air Strike now moves Monferno back and gives it Wait after knocking out its opponent.
Cosmo Energy now ends your turn when activated, with updated Plate text.
Mayhem Tower results include Duel Log alongside Match ID and Replay.
Duel logs and the local overlay API now report evolution, Mega Evolution and reversion, form changes, and type changes.
Fixed field-spin positioning in vertical layout and kept results in the duel orientation until you leave.
Added Discord help for update download problems.
Included the browser Elite Four recovery and campaign team-picker layout fixes.

entries.title: Move fixes and ranked adjustments
changes: Fang Finale now excludes Cracked opponents that land Purple Attacks.
Shattered Psyche offers all valid three-step destinations, including the route through the top-left entry point.
Updated the standalone title artwork in native and browser menus.

New human ranked rating bands: below 500 difference, +25/-15; 500–999, higher +25/-20 and lower +30/-15; 1000–1999, higher +20/-25 and lower +30/-10; 2000+, higher +15/-30 and lower +40/-5. Draws remain unchanged.
Bot scoring keeps its existing formula below 1600; rating gains and losses stop at 1600 and above.
Ranked rating changes activate after the matching account-server update is installed.

entries.title: Battle fixes
changes: Fixed Ultra Necrozma remaining transformed after Ultra Burst ends.
Moved ability buttons to the top in vertical layout and improved touch controls.
Fixed Rocky Helmet triggering after Judgment and other non-knockout moves.

entries.title: Battle fixes
changes: Knock Off now removes only Plates attached to its target.
Precipice Blades and Origin Pulse only count extra Misses from Burn and Paralysis.
Fixed Mayhem leaderboard run status.
Fire Fang now burns on wins, losses and draws against White, Gold and Miss.
Larger Plates in the Team Editor, with fewer cards per row.
Improved Windows update downloads.

entries.title: Ranked seasons
changes: Added Ranked seasons, with ratings resetting to 1000 each season.
Added season history, podium totals and previous-season results to account stats and player cards.
Added a Seasons selector for previous Ranked leaderboards.
Updated rank thresholds. Wins award at least 10 RP; losses cost at most 20 RP.
Leaderboard entry now needs one Ranked game, including bots. Season awards require 10 human Ranked games.
Improved account stats layout, fixed leaderboard loading and renamed Searching Ranked to Searching Online.

entries.title: Browser fixes and Cofagrigus EX
changes: Fixed browser duels failing to start or showing missing artwork.
Fixed the hub Collection preview and figure count.
Cofagrigus EX now follows the normal three-copy deck limit.

entries.title: Casual banner and bot timer
changes: Casual matchmaking now uses its own banner, and the overlapping Casual label has been removed.
Bot delay now uses a slider from 3 to 10 minutes, in one-minute steps.

entries.title: Custom lobbies and Casual matchmaking
changes: Added custom lobby settings for timers, first player, turn limits, Plates and Gym Rules.
Gym Rules give matching Pokémon +1 MP and +20 damage and use the matching Gym arena.
Added Casual mode under Online Matchmaking: no rating changes, and a chest only when you win.
Mayhem leaderboard Pokéballs show whether a run is ongoing or ended.
Improved the goal victory camera and removed zoom-ins for other match endings.
Fixed Butterfree’s Whirlwind description and lingering target circles after AI Reckless Charge.

entries.title: Battle fixes and browser improvements
changes: Fixed Curse-marker exclusion against Arceus: Multitype prevents exclusion from attack effects, not markers.
Fixed Fang Finale excluding Cracked opponents after White/Gold/Miss wins, losses and draws, including figures with other forms. Blue and Purple outcomes remain exempt.
Fixed Magikarp offering a knockout evolution when an effect excludes it or sends it to Ultra Space.
Fixed Snorlax’s Pulverizing Pancake applying a normal damage knockout after pushing its opponent back.
Deoxys finishes its form-change presentation before the Z-Move choice opens.
Standard Groudon and Kyogre can select their Primal form in the team builder.
Mayhem Tower preserves a completed win while retrying result synchronization.
Fixed AI-forfeit classification on the account server so surrendering to a ranked bot cannot grant rewards.
Untimed portrait matches no longer display placeholder clocks; portrait board framing and arena coverage are improved.
The camera stays on the winning Pokémon after a whole-match victory.
Fixed native Settings buttons being blocked while matchmaking search is active.
Corrected move-description typos for Heatmor, Mega Absol and Mega Kangaskhan.

Replaced browser menus with lightweight HTML menus matching the Windows fixed-ratio layouts and controls, including team editing, forms, evolutions, plates, enhancement, saved wheel modifications, challenges, Tower, matchmaking, lobbies, chat, settings, history and announcements.
Browser play requires sign-in or account creation. Board availability and separate team selection follow the native game.
Corrected Mayhem leaderboard floors, menu overflow, panel clipping and banner fitting; added the app-download recommendation on menu screens.
Reduced browser battle-animation rendering work while keeping figure and attack animations enabled.
Browser menus prepare common battle assets after sign-in and selected-team figures, evolutions and forms while choosing a match, with a small footer progress indicator.
Fixed mobile browser wheel battles clipping after rotation in either orientation.
Removed the extra browser duel toolbar and status strip during play. Loading errors retain a return-to-menu control.

entries.title: Rotation layout correction
changes: Fixed Settings and Pause staying off-center after rotating back to landscape.
Fixed battle panels drifting outside the screen after repeated rotations, including during an active wheel spin.
Includes the portrait battles, AUTO-ROTATE BATTLES setting and mobile first-turn hint from v1.2.4.
The same correction is live in the browser. No account-server update is required.

entries.title: Automatic portrait battles
changes: Rotate your phone or tablet during a match to switch between portrait and the normal landscape board, including wheel battles. Menus remain horizontal.
AUTO-ROTATE BATTLES in Settings lets you disable the feature. The choice is remembered per device.
A mobile-only animated phone beside Settings and Chat introduces rotation until your first turn ends.
Fixed missing landscape controls after starting a match in portrait. The current turn and wheel spin are preserved during rotation.
The same update is available in the mobile browser. No account-server update is required.

entries.title: Cofagrigus EX mist and AI-forfeit rewards
changes: Added soft drifting mist around Cofagrigus EX. The mist follows the figure animation setting.
Fixed Cofagrigus EX being skipped by the figure animation filter.
Forfeiting against an AI opponent no longer grants a chest. Forfeiting against a human opponent still grants the usual chest. The account-server update is deployed.
The same figure effect is included in the Windows/Android patch and browser game.

entries.title: Cofagrigus and Cosmoem fixes
changes: Mummy replaces the live Ability and appears on the card and in Active Effects. Eligible affected Pokemon spread Mummy through battles.
The original Ability returns on leaving the field, evolving, devolving, or another Ability-changing effect. Tagging and status recovery do not cure Mummy.
King Mummy gains +1 MP per other friendly Yamask or Cofagrigus on the field, up to 3 MP. Eligible opponents that MP move over Cofagrigus EX receive Mummy.
Nightmare of The Ancient Mummy applies the same Ability change with its existing animation.
Fixed Cosmoem's Black Core evolution prompt after a Teleport surround.
Ranked AI matches do not change rating above 1600, and AI games do not affect win/loss/draw counters. Historical statistics were corrected without deleting replays or changing historical ratings.
Includes the same released fixes for Windows, Android and the browser game.

entries.title: Figure progression references
changes: Enhancement and Wheel Modification resolve figure references through the shared catalog.
The account-server update archived and reconciled older ID/path progression records while preserving earned progression.
Browser v1.2.1 includes all v1.1.9 and v1.2.0 content and fixes.

entries.title: Cofagrigus gift visibility
changes: Gift requests and acknowledgements report the running patch version instead of the installer version.
Outdated figure catalogs refresh after patch updates. Cofagrigus EX appears in New Figures.

entries.title: Cofagrigus EX and Mega Evolution emblem
changes: Added Cofagrigus EX, King Mummy and its signature Nightmare of The Ancient Mummy Z-Move.
Started the Cofagrigus EX launch gift campaign; the original seven-day reveal window remains in effect.
The Mega Evolution emblem appears during the white-light transition.
Includes the approved Celebi, Mega Sableye, Dark Energy, menu-message and replay fixes.

entries.title: Teams, Ranked Preferences and Battle Fixes
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE v1.1.8
TEAMS, RANKED PREFERENCES AND DATABASE

Added multiple favourite teams, toggled with a standalone star beside each team. Favourite teams stay above other teams on every saved-team screen, while keeping the selected sort order within each group. Account favourites sync between installations; local teams keep their favourites on the device.

Added a saved Ranked bot delay, adjustable before and during matchmaking from 30 seconds to 10 minutes. Default keeps the existing rank-based timings. Duel clocks and human-opponent priority are unchanged.

Added Database → Figure Usage, with My Figures and Global Figures tabs showing portraits, match-appearance counts and percentages across all completed recorded modes. Each starting figure counts once per side per duel; global totals count both sides separately. Earlier recordings are added in the background; records without team data are excluded.
BATTLE FIXES
Mega Gardevoir's Cerebral Embrace now limits the remaining action to Mega Gardevoir's MP move, attack or End Turn. Pokémon switched onto the field finish their entry Abilities before play continues.
Fixed Regigigas receiving Thankfulness's extra MP after other effects had already raised it above MP1. Max Revive can now restore Regigigas from the P.C.

Knock Off now cancels one active Plate effect on its battle opponent in White/Gold damage matchups, including when Knock Off loses. Cancelling the active Mega Evolution Plate also ends that Mega Evolution.
Fixed Override and similar adjacent status effects losing their targets when the opposing move relocates the user.
Shattered Psyche now offers movement after the battle's knockout and relocation effects finish, and only while its user remains on the field.
Playful Punch now pushes along the battle's straight line instead of bending into other lanes, including when its user is knocked out.
Sweet Scent no longer gives its user Wait. An already-adjacent selected Pokémon receives the Wait instead.
Z-Move secondary effects now resolve when losing a White/Gold damage comparison, while respecting legal targets and movement restrictions.
Fixed Hyper Beam and similar forced-turn effects creating an extra skipped turn against the AI.
MAYHEM AND QUESTS
Identity Crisis no longer selects None as a random Ability. Older replays retain their original Ability rolls.
Fixed quest replacement buttons blinking during background quest refreshes.

entries.title: Clocks, Replays and Battle Fixes
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE v1.1.7
ONLINE CLOCKS
Match clocks now synchronize regularly with the host so both players see the same time reference.
A client-side clock reaching zero no longer decides a loss by itself. The host validates timer expiry before ending the duel.
Both clocks remain paused during connection recovery and automatic battle presentation; interactive choices still use the chooser's time.
BATTLE FIXES AND PRESENTATION

Fixed Shed Skin not offering its special-condition recovery at the start of your turn. Accepting it removes the condition, offers evolution when eligible, and ends the turn once; declining keeps your turn.
Fixed Mega Gardevoir retaining attack targets beside its old position after using Cerebral Embrace. Attacks are checked from its current position.
Added a short camera zoom and goal-burst effect when a figure scores. This follows your battle animation setting.
REPLAYS
Added a viewing-side button to switch between Player 1 and Player 2 while paused between actions.
Fixed rapid Previous Turn, Next Turn and Restart clicks causing repeated scene reloads or replay crashes.
Older replay recordings keep their original Shed Skin choice sequence.
TEAMS, CHALLENGE MODE AND MENUS
Saved team creation dates now sync with the account, keeping Newest First ordering consistent across installations.
Fixed returning to an empty Elite Four menu when account synchronization fails. The menu stays usable and pending results remain saved for retry.
Fixed Tower hearts showing stale lives when returning before the result finishes saving. The page refreshes as soon as the save completes.
Tower lives now use clear red and grey hearts plus a numeric life count, including on mobile.
Corrected garbled Pokémon text in update installation and restart messages.

entries.title: Battle and Campaign Fixes
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE v1.1.6
BATTLE FIXES
Frozen Pokémon now keep an all-Miss wheel when effects such as Guardian Sphere or Mega Beedrill would otherwise change their Miss segments.
Ultra Necrozma’s Neuroforce now reverses damage boosts from its battle opponent’s own Ability, while leaving buffs from allied Pokémon intact.
Blue Flare and Bolt Strike respect the battle color rules and do not inflict Burn or Paralysis when defeated by Purple or Blue moves.
Switching between Mega Mewtwo X and Y now uses each form’s saved upgraded wheel, including the shiny forms.
CONTROLS
On the installed desktop game, hold Shift while clicking End Turn to skip the optional remaining-actions confirmation. Required actions and other turn restrictions still apply.
CAMPAIGN AND COMMUNITY
Fixed a server error when saving Elite Four and Champion results that could prevent affected runs from continuing. Existing progress and rewards are preserved.
Added support for Discord channel counters showing online players and players searching for or playing ranked matches.

entries.title: Emergency Zones Fix
changes: Fixed no scrollbar or exit button on zones.

entries.title: Mayhem, Replays, Zones & Chat Improvements
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE — v1.1.4
MAYHEM
Six of a Kind now gives both teams the same rarity, while each team still has six copies of its selected Pokémon.
Clarified Unstable Evolution: C, UC and R Pokémon can evolve into eligible EX Pokémon from another evolution line.
REPLAYS AND ZONES
Added WATCH REPLAY to the end-of-match menu so you can rewatch the match directly after its result is saved.
Renamed ULTRA SPACE to ZONES. Ultra Space and excluded Pokémon now appear in separate visual sections for each player.
Return choices for Ultra Space and excluded Pokémon now show figure images, team slots and their last board positions, making identical figures easier to distinguish.
Zone lists and return choices support scrolling and figure-card previews on mobile.
FIGURES AND CHAT
Added a NEW FIGURES tab to Balance Changes, showing all 12 Challenge Mode reward figures with hover or tap previews.
Moved new reward figures out of the Changes tab into New Figures.
Added separate DUEL and GENERAL chat tabs during online matches, so you can follow the community chat without leaving your duel conversation.
Chat drafts, typing and notifications stay separate between the two tabs. Player mutes and reports remain available.
BROWSER
Balance Changes now loads both tabs' figure cards and images together when opened, instead of loading full figures on each hover.
Lightweight previews are reused while the panel is open and released when it closes.
MUSIC
Renamed Original Duel 4 to Practice Duel Theme.
Renamed Original Duel 5 to Don Roger Theme.

entries.title: Elite Four Sync, Battle Fixes & DuelDB Overlay Support
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE — v1.1.3
ELITE FOUR PROGRESS
Active Elite Four runs and their locked teams now sync to your account, allowing you to continue the same run on another device or browser.
Existing runs are preserved. Open your current run on its original device while signed in to sync it first.
Interrupted result saves can retry safely without granting the same rewards twice.
BATTLE FIXES
Fixed premature Wait losses when Backtrack, knockouts or follow-up movement such as Jet Kick temporarily blocked an Entry Point. Defeat is now checked after the interaction finishes.
Both duel clocks now pause during disconnect recovery and resynchronization, preventing time from running out while the game blocks input.
Fixed Mega Blaziken incorrectly activating regular Blaziken's Fire Power after a knockout. Flare Blitz keeps its own printed knockout effect.
Fixed Black Kyurem's Freeze Shock and White Kyurem's Ice Burn inflicting status through Purple moves such as Fly.
Groudon's Lava Plume now burns only when Groudon is knocked out by a White or Gold attack. Removed the duplicate burn text.
Red Orb and Blue Orb can now be recycled once their Primal effect is no longer active on the field.
Restored the Mayhem indicator in replays without restarting the recorded conditions or affecting Tower progress.
DESKTOP OVERLAYS
Added overlay support for DuelDB.

entries.title: New Features, Improvements & Fixes
changes: ✨ POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE — v1.1.0
Updates introducing in-game chat, player reporting, Wheel Builds, Tower lives, improved rewards, and numerous gameplay and interface fixes.
💬 IN-GAME CHAT & COMMUNITY
Added chat throughout the hub, menus and online matches.
Lobby chat is also available during single-player duels, including Challenge Mode, Mayhem Tower and AI battles.
Move the chat window by dragging its title and resize it using a mouse or finger.
Click a username to open the player's profile, mute them or report them.
Chat usernames retain a consistent colour throughout the session.
Mentions display a red notification badge, and messages that ping you are highlighted.
Press Enter to complete the first suggested @mention, then Enter again to send.
Opening chat automatically displays the latest messages.
Chat follows new messages while you are at the bottom. Scrolling up pauses this until you return.
Added typing indicators, including your own typing.
Removed the Resize label while keeping resizing available.
Added chat-ban support.
Added counters showing players online and players searching Ranked on the hub, online menu and Ranked search screens.
🚩 PLAYER REPORTING
Report offensive chat, cheating, bad behaviour, glitch abuse and other issues.
Reports require a written explanation.
Match reports include the Match ID and available chat history with usernames.
Reports submitted during a duel are delivered after the match ends to include the full conversation.
Reports from menu chat include the latest 100 messages.
🛠️ WHEEL BUILDS, UPGRADES & TEAMS
Added Wheel Builds for level 10 figures!
Save up to five builds, including Default, using your earned upgrade points for free.
Select builds separately for each team slot and form through a searchable, scrollable list.
Added a dedicated WHEEL BUILDS button at the bottom of Wheel Modification.
Wheel edits update previews immediately and are applied together through Save Changes.
Reset Wheel returns allocated points while preserving figure levels and XP.
Saved wheel changes now appear immediately in teams and new matches.
Fixed upgrades reducing multiple equally sized Miss segments.
Redistribution now requires the initial expansion upgrades first.
Invalid reductions return their redistribution points while preserving levels and valid upgrades.
Fixed Shiny Ditto and Challenge reward figures displaying inconsistent levels, incorrectly refusing upgrades or showing incorrect wheel modifications.
Added sorting by figure level in Team Builder and Collection.
Added reordering of Pokémon and plates within teams.
⚔️ BATTLE RULES, ABILITIES & MOVE EFFECTS
Multiplication and division now resolve before damage buffs and debuffs. Chain Level damage remains part of base damage.
Swift Swim grants +1 MP beside a Water-type Pokémon and +1 MP during rain. These bonuses stack to +2 MP.
Attacks from range 2 or 3 protect the attacker from the defending move's effects while preserving the defender's own protection effects.
Confusion applies only to the initial spin of a spin-again attack, including when confusion shifts a Blue result onto that attack.
Confusion always shifts at least one segment. Its animation also appears when the shift wraps back to the original move.
X-Speed converts every White segment sharing the selected attack's name to Gold for that turn.
Porygon's Trace cannot target Mega Pokémon. Copied abilities retain their other effects, but their form-changing effects are ignored.
Starmie's Analytic now accounts for star bonuses already active from plates and passives.
Fiery Breath spins only the selected eligible Pokémon.
Ponyta, Rapidash and Rhyperior can use a plate before activating their abilities.
Kyogre, Groudon and their Primal forms no longer provide passive buffs while excluded or in Ultra Space.
Red Orb and Blue Orb buffs apply only while the corresponding Primal figure is on the field.
Fixed Backtrack resetting evolutions, Mega Evolutions, forms and plate effects.
Reflect Move allows players to choose eligible jump destinations.
Fixed conflicting knockout effects leaving figures stuck. Exclusion takes priority.
Fixed AI Aura Sphere and other chosen knockout effects sacrificing teammates when an eligible opponent is available, including the AI's goalie.
Duel logs now name the new type when Arceus, Silvally or Type: Null changes type.
Corrected the Konck typo in Swampert's Z-Move description.
🏆 CHALLENGE MODE & REWARDS
Fixed some Challenge Mode AI teams failing to load.
Repeat Challenge reward bundles now have a 5% drop chance across every difficulty, including Gym Leaders, Elite Four members and Champions.
Abandoning an Elite Four run no longer restores first-clear rewards for members already defeated.
New Hard Elite Four runs prohibit Ultra Beasts alongside the existing Mega Evolution restriction. Existing runs retain their previous eligibility.
Limited Celebi to one per team. Existing Elite Four runs can finish with their saved teams.
Fixed overflowing reward displays and scrolling with mouse or touch, including during paused battles.
❤️ MAYHEM TOWER LIVES
Added two lives to Tower runs!
Existing runs also receive two lives.
Losing or leaving a Tower battle costs one life. Losing both ends the run.
Clearing every twentieth floor restores lives to two.
🎁 GUARANTEED RANKED CHESTS
Every completed Ranked match now awards a material chest.
Wins and draws use the full rarity odds.
Losses halve higher-rarity odds, with the remaining chance going to Common.
🎨 INTERFACE & LOADING
Collection now caches figure cards for faster return visits.
Added a Collection loading progress bar.
Account entry waits for figures and inventory to finish loading, preventing temporary level 1 figures or empty inventories.
Fixed mobile figure-viewer dragging rotating incorrectly or zooming instead.
Added separate duel dark mode to dim the board floor independently of menu dark mode. It remains off by default.
Hover over figures in balance updates to preview their cards. On mobile, tap to open a scrollable card and tap outside to close.
Removed bracket markers from balance notes.
Fixed the hub update banner cropping its artwork, title and slogan.
Reduced banner navigation dots and their background to 35% opacity.
Fixed custom-lobby header text overlapping team controls.
Fixed duplicate settings buttons on Wheel Modification.
Moved Veen's credit into Art Design Replacements.
🎵 NEW MUSIC OPTIONS
Added Original Duel 4 and 5, each with its corresponding danger theme.
Random Original Duel music now includes all five tracks.
Added Original Menu 2 and the Original Quest Theme to menu music options.
🌐 ONLINE STABILITY & UPDATER
Continued work on mobile interface and online availability issues.
Reduced database load and improved error handling to address account and Ranked timeouts.
Improved online-room reconnection and player-slot recovery.
Fixed attack-effect texture-processing errors associated with battle freezes.
Added support for smaller updates and downloading missing patches in version order.
Improved update validation and recovery, including a Repair Update option in Settings.

entries.title: A New Era Begins! — The Official Release
changes: 🎉 POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE 1.0.0 — A NEW ERA BEGINS!
The wait is finally over! After months of development, Pokémon Duel Remake is officially leaving the Beta phase!

Our biggest and most ambitious update yet introduces a completely redesigned interface, new Pokémon, stunning animations, expanded challenges, a revamped progression system, and massive balance changes.
Thank you to everyone who helped make this incredible milestone possible. The Beta is over, but our journey is only beginning!
🎨 COMPLETE UI OVERHAUL
Completely redesigned menus with a cleaner, more modern appearance and brighter blue accents.
Improved navigation and layouts throughout the game.
Redesigned Pokémon cards with clearer information and improved readability.
Refreshed inventory interface for easier collection and resource management.
Dark Mode is now the default theme.
Light Mode is available through Settings.
🌟 12 NEW POKÉMON FIGURES
Paras and Parasect join the battle!
Kabutops makes its debut!
Starmie and Mega Starmie are now available!
Buneary, Lopunny, and Mega Lopunny join the collection!
Chatot joins the battlefield!
Porygon makes its debut!
Palkia (Origin Forme) and Dialga (Origin Forme) are now available!
Discover new strategies and expand your collection with these 12 new figures!
✨ NEW FIGURE & BATTLE ANIMATIONS
Added animated visual effects for EX, UX, and NX figures.
Shiny Pokémon now sparkle with special star effects.
Expanded battle animations with more animated attacks and move effects.
Improved the visual presentation of battles to bring back more of the original Pokémon Duel experience.
Animations can be disabled through Settings for players who prefer improved performance.
🏆 CHALLENGE MODE — THE ROAD TO CHAMPION
Challenge the Gym Leaders, Elite Four, and Champions of Kanto and Sinnoh!
Face opponents with unique mechanics and special battle abilities.
Normal Difficulty: Begin your journey and conquer each region.
Hard Difficulty: Face stronger opponents and additional restrictions.
Expert Difficulty: Take on the ultimate challenge designed for experienced players.
Earn badges, overcome legendary challenges, and unlock exclusive rewards!
🗼 MAYHEM TOWER — THE CHAOS CONTINUES
Added two new Mayhems to Mayhem Tower!
Climb the tower and face unpredictable battles with unique rules and anomalies.
Adapt your strategies to randomly generated opponents and changing battle conditions.
Push your limits and see how far you can climb!
💎 NEW FIGURE LEVELING & UPGRADE SYSTEM
Introduced a revamped progression system using Rare Metals and Chain Cubes.
Rare Metals are used to increase figure levels and improve attack wheels.
Chain Cubes increase your Pokémon's chain damage.
Gold is no longer required to level up figures!
Collect upgrade materials to strengthen your favorite Pokémon and customize their wheels.
🎁 ANIMATED CHEST OPENINGS & INVENTORY
Added animated chest openings to make collecting rewards more exciting.
Improved the presentation of upgrade materials and rewards.
Refreshed the inventory interface for easier management of chests, materials, and collectibles.
👤 TRAINER CUSTOMIZATION & AVATAR SHOP
Customize your trainer with new personalization options!
Visit the Avatar Shop to unlock customization options using Gold.
Express your personality and make your trainer stand out from the competition!
⚖️ MASSIVE FIGURE BALANCE UPDATE
Over 70 Pokémon figures have received balance changes!
Updated and reworked Pokémon Abilities.
Adjusted attack effects and battle interactions.
Rebalanced attack damage and wheel segment distributions.
Updated Movement Points (MP) for selected figures.
Adjusted figure rarities.
Discover new team compositions, rethink your strategies, and prepare for a completely refreshed competitive meta!
❤️ THANK YOU FOR AN INCREDIBLE BETA!
Version 1.0.0 marks a major milestone in the history of Pokémon Duel Remake.
Every bug report, suggestion, battle, and encouraging message helped shape the game into what it is today.
This release would not have been possible without the support and passion of our amazing community.
And this is only the beginning! More Pokémon, features, improvements, and surprises are coming in future updates.
THE BETA IS OVER. THE DUEL CONTINUES!
